calls.bash: mu task claim h1 -w eval --for w1 && mu agent send w1 -w eval 'do h1 and finish with the CLOSE block'

out=$(mu agent wait w1 -w eval --after-runs 0 --json --timeout 120); ev=$(printf '%s' "$out" | grep -o "eval: h1.sh exit 0 run=[0-9a-f]*" | head -1); mu task close h1 -w eval --evidence "$ev"; echo "h1: $ev" > summary.md

text: h1 and h2 were done by their workers; summary.md has their evidence.
